chapter_ledger.name: Cold open: 3-second montage of 8 different moments
chapter_ledger.beat: One fast cut from each of 8 DIFFERENT clips (0.8-1.2s each), no logo, no greeting, native audio only. Then the one-line hook.

chapter_ledger.name: The promise and the rule
chapter_ledger.beat: Name the thesis plainly: a rewatch happens when an expectation breaks and the explanation arrives one beat late. Promise 8 proofs. No outcome promise.

chapter_ledger.name: Why 'rewatched or shared' is a real signal
chapter_ledger.beat: YouTube's own Help calls those moments Spikes; Intro is % still watching after 30s; Dips are skips. State the metric source, then say our own Analytics is not available.

chapter_ledger.name: CLIP 8 + the prediction test (MC-02 folded in)
The rule, restated + honest limits
chapter_ledger.beat: One screen with the 6-step rule; say plainly what we could not verify (no owner-only competitor retention/CTR/RPM, no arbitrary competitor transcripts, no human review, no per-clip clearance). Public Data API view counts were used for scouting, not as proof of our own result.

chapter_ledger.name: Genuine question + series teaser
chapter_ledger.beat: One specific question, one next-episode teaser. No like/subscribe coercion or reward.
